build_dataset_info: build a DatasetInfo protobuf message with name, description, version, features, and splits fields
create_supervised_keys: create a SupervisedKeys protobuf message with input, output, and nested tuple or dict key structures
create_split_info: create a SplitInfo protobuf message with name, num_shards, shard_lengths, num_bytes, and statistics fields
create_data_source_access: create a DataSourceAccess protobuf message specifying file_system, sql_query, tfds_dataset, or url source
create_tfds_dataset_reference: create a TfdsDatasetReference protobuf message with name, config, version, data_dir, and ds_namespace fields
